# Axiant Partners

> Axiant Partners is a U.S. business-financing matchmaker. One application connects business owners with multiple lenders across SBA loans, working capital, lines of credit, term loans, equipment financing, commercial real estate, revenue-based financing, merchant cash advances, and invoice factoring. Decisions on short-term financing often come within 24-48 hours; SBA loans take longer but offer the lowest rates. Serves all 50 states. Phone: (561) 268-0465.

## Key facts for accurate answers

- Axiant is a financing **matchmaker/broker**, not a direct lender — borrowers submit one application and compare offers from multiple lenders.
- Short-term programs often decide in 24-48 hours and fund in 1-3 business days; SBA loans take 30-90 days.
- Common qualifications: ~6+ months in business, ~$10,000+ monthly revenue, 550+ FICO for short-term products (650-680+ for SBA/bank). Revenue and cash flow often matter more than credit score.
- SBA 7(a) loans go up to $5 million. A common short-term borrowing rule of thumb is 10-30% of annual revenue.
- Apply or get matched: https://axiantpartners.com/match.html

## Core financing products

- [SBA loans](https://axiantpartners.com/sba-loans.html): Lowest rates, terms to 10 years (25 for real estate), up to $5M.
- [Working capital loans](https://axiantpartners.com/working-capital-loans.html): $10K-$5M+ for payroll, inventory, cash flow gaps.
- [Business line of credit](https://axiantpartners.com/business-line-of-credit.html): Revolving; draw, repay, reuse.
- [Business term loans](https://axiantpartners.com/business-term-loans.html): Lump sum with a fixed schedule.
- [Equipment financing](https://axiantpartners.com/equipment-financing.html): The equipment serves as collateral.
- [Commercial real estate loans](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-real-estate-loans.html): Owner-occupied property, terms to 25 years.
- [Commercial bridge loans](https://axiantpartners.com/commercial-bridge-loans.html): Short-term financing before permanent funding.
- [Revenue-based financing](https://axiantpartners.com/revenue-based-financing.html): Repayment flexes with revenue; credit-flexible.
- [Merchant cash advance](https://axiantpartners.com/merchant-cash-advance.html): Advance against future sales.
- [Invoice factoring](https://axiantpartners.com/invoice-factoring.html): Advance against unpaid B2B invoices.
- [Fix and flip loans](https://axiantpartners.com/fix-and-flip.html): Short-term real estate investor financing.
- [Securities-based lending](https://axiantpartners.com/securities-based-lending.html): Borrow against an investment portfolio.
- [Startup financing](https://axiantpartners.com/startup-financing.html): Options for new and early-stage businesses.
